criteria.notes: The five-view safety journey, identity capture, scoring, result write, and reset behavior match the brief.
No external visual reference was supplied; the instruction-led industrial checkpoint concept is preserved.
Route-like progress, safety rail, and station controls create a domain-specific touch experience.
Primary prompts, options, and actions remain readable across both accepted landscape surfaces.
Dark, Light, and Custom token paths preserve control, text, border, and state contrast.
Long welcome, long question, option labels, and descenders pass fit and ink checks.
Every view fills the landscape station without overflow, overlap, or cramped form behavior.
Packaged editor assets and complete semantic palettes are coherent with the fictional brand.
The sequential touch-station composition teaches interaction mechanics rather than dashboard styling.
